name: Laura Woods
researchKeywords: cancer epidemiology, cancer outcomes, screening, social inequalities
bio: Dr Laura Woods, PhD is a cancer epidemiologist and Senior Lecturer in Public Health at Newcastle University's Population Health Sciences Institute.
researchFocus: Laura studies social inequalities in cancer outcomes, particularly inequalities associated with early diagnosis and screening. Her doctoral research compared breast cancer survival and cure by social deprivation in England and Australia, and she has led research into differences in cancer outcomes for more than 15 years.

professionalRoles.title: Former Postdoctoral Fellow
professionalRoles.organisation: Cancer Research UK and London School of Hygiene and Tropical Medicine
